title: John Harbaugh: I'm not "too worried" about Malik Nabers commenting on Giants draft

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Harbaugh: I'm not "too worried" about Malik Nabers commenting on Giants draft
sources.description: Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers offered some real-time reactions to the team's first-round picks on Thursday night and they led to a conversation with head coach John Harbaugh.
